evidence_slice: Historic England's official NHLE record for List Entry 1495589 identifies Exeter Central Station at 3 Central Station Buildings, Queen Street, Exeter, EX4 3SB, Grade II, first listed 24 July 2026. Its summary/details explicitly identify a railway station with attached shops and offices, plus a footbridge and luggage way. The legal section states that the listed building is shown coloured blue on the attached map and links a full-scale map PDF. The linked PDF endpoint returned a cache miss before any PDF payload could be read, and the HTML record contains no polygon coordinate payload. No footprint geometry was inferred or fabricated.
